goal: Allow bitcoin-gui to connect to an already running bitcoin-node process via IPC
Enable starting and stopping the GUI independently without restarting the background node
reviewability: The branch contains only one unique commit on top of several open multiprocess base PRs
agreement: Strong concept support for independent GUI attachment (laanwj, meshcollider)
Testing confirmed SSH socket forwarding works, though edge-case node crashes during disconnect were reported (Sjors, jimhashhq)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it delivers a core objective of the process separation project
Allows bitcoin-gui to attach and detach dynamically from a running node daemon

result.summary: Adds an `-ipcconnect` argument to `bitcoin-gui` to connect the interface over IPC to an existing `bitcoin-node` process via a domain socket rather than spawning a new node subprocess. It supports auto-discovery of existing sockets, fallback spawning, and explicit custom socket paths.
result.problem: Previously, multiprocess GUI execution required the GUI to spawn and manage its own internal or subprocess node, preventing users from attaching a graphical interface to an already running node daemon or disconnecting without shutting down the node.

open_concerns: Node can throw unhandled IpcExceptions if the GUI process terminates abruptly or during specific node shutdown sequences
Connecting bitcoin-gui without `-disablewallet` to a bitcoin-node running with `-disablewallet` crashes the node (tracked in libmultiprocess#169)
resolved_concerns: AddArg formatting and parameter consistency with existing CLI arguments addressed in base PRs

reviewability.label: Review #19460 first
reviewability.reason: The code is technically reviewable and CI passes, but this PR contains only a single commit stacked on top of open PRs #10102, #29409, and #19460.

agreement.summary: Concept approved by laanwj and meshcollider; testing by Sjors validated functionality over SSH tunneling with base edge-case issues tracked
agreement.reason: There is broad agreement on the feature and interface design. Concrete testing issues raised regarding shutdown and mismatched wallet flags were traced back to base branch logic or filed as follow-ups.

result.card: multiprocess: Add bitcoin-gui -ipcconnect option adds an argument allowing bitcoin-gui to connect to an existing bitcoin-node process via domain sockets. This addresses the limitation where running the multiprocess GUI required spawning a captive node instance, preventing independent daemon lifecycles. Concept consensus is strong with demonstrated manual testing across SSH tunnels, though edge-case termination exceptions remain under review. The PR depends on several upstream multiprocess PRs (#10102, #29409, #19460) and contains only one commit unique to itself.
